title: Glow Up!
description: A datapack that generates particle effects around a player based on their score
body:
This datapack enhances your game experience with glowing particles around you! Toggle them on and off with a command and shine with every step.



You can use the following commands:


/function glowup:enchant


/function glowup:heart


/function glowup:instant


/function glowup:angry


/function glowup:stop
